scope: Geometry-selected DEV seed 0; 24 predeclared queries, selected after enabled batch began. No outcome selection.
source_identity: Historical Git/source-snapshot provenance is checked by batch.verify; every prepared control manifest must retain exact equality of source and roadmap hashes to enabled manifest; each receipt and request is verified. Current working-tree source equality is required only by execution/resume, not this retrospective reader.
selection_timing: Selection was defined after the enabled full-DEV seed-0 experiment had already partially run; it is geometry-only but was not prospective to that run.
scene_grouping: Each chosen case comes from a distinct obstacle scene; do not pool two tracks as independent scenes.

frontends.note: Null when either frontend path is absent. Differences do not erase end-to-end results but prevent claiming an identical-initial-path pair.

coverage.metrics_note: Metrics are separated by objective because distance and time have different units.
